name: Ethiopia
about: Dry season (Oct–Mar) is best for both trekking and sightseeing across the highlands, including Lalibela; heavy rains Jun–Sep make travel and trail conditions harder.
overview: Ethiopia's dramatic range in one country — Simien Mountains trekking among gelada monkeys, Lalibela's rock-hewn churches, and world-class birding.
costOverview: Coffee and injera cost next to nothing day to day — but a Simien trek adds a mandatory daily scout fee, and pairing the mountains with Lalibela's churches usually means a domestic flight.

costItems.label: Guided trek package, guide + scout + mules
